name: Offset-centre 2R pointer with a sliding twist sleeve at the cuff
verdict: screened after polish (score 78.58, gap 58.90 vs bar 74.9 / 68.93), with a caveat: the shoulder half (hub 2, bar cap, bar arm run) still floats >= 32 mm off the skin (4-13 % in band); the cuff end and hub 1 carry the in-band number. Not converged by the gate (best at eval 193/252, last third) but on a flat ridge (+0.26 over the second half, top-5 within 0.12)
limiter: (1) rod line O->C converges on O at ~15 deg to the arm: the rod clamp sinks ~0.27 mm per mm of slide travel into the deltoid (boss contact 11 poses at o 0, 139/220 at o 10); (2) the bar's run down the lateral arm (a quarter of all metal samples) is 0-4 % in band, median >= 32 mm, in every config: its roll is set by a1 x dh, not by the arm, so it must clear every axial rotation; (3) J2 hub 0-4 % in band (posterior-lateral cap filled by the elevated arm); red team: 11 across-body poses (plane >= 110) lose the cuff end inside the body, pinch 0.25 mm at the rod clamp (plane 122 elev 31 axial -80 flex 122)
note: bench fast Bench(60,160), K3 march, K2 dense (values + axes), part clearance >= 1 mm + 1 mm sampling slack, bar over link 1 by construction; spec fixed: C0 on the bench skin (q90 of the arm's own outer skin), U at real size (ring + cheeks); headline = bench best k 113 (degenerate, see verdict); best non-degenerate k 86: gap 88.62 reach 0.7625 follow 0.8833 ib14 0.4225 ib10 0.2431 contact 0.2045; POLISH 2026-10-15: 252 farm evaluations (model's own evaluate), best k 306 gap 58.90 (score 78.58), convergence gate failed only on 'best in last third' (flat ridge)
audit: Death refuted on the number, not on the idea. The 'best non-degenerate 88.62' (k86) was a coarse-grid artifact: the bar azimuth dpsi was swept only over {-45,0,45} at q .9/.95 and later refined around +45; dpsi 0 with q 0.97-0.98 gives 79.11 / 76.42 (reach .8125, follow .95, ib14 .3733, contact .15) with hub1 (median 16.7 mm) and link1 (13.9 mm) still near the skin. The degenerate/non-degenerate line does not hold: hub2 sits 104 mm out on its axis even in k86 and is 0-4 % in band in every config, so the gap curve over q is continuous 88.6 -> 79.1 -> 76.4 -> 71.15. No modelling bug or convention error found (closure, continuity, contact, sampling match the baseline; strap width 12 vs 8 moves the gap < 1). Still behind 68.93: the J2 hub (axis a1 x dh floats >100 mm) and the bar run (roll not tied to the humerus, 1-10 % in band) are the measured limiters; the centre offset itself stays harmful (not re-measured).
v_note: audit Bench(60,160) fast: k86 + dpsi 0 + q 0.98 -> gap 76.42; q 0.97 -> 79.11; + a1 bvec(85,78) -> 75.09 (link1 floats); v_inband10 not printed by the audit run

polish.note: q 0.98 + width 10 + J1 axis bvec(77.5,78) + s 189: leaving q 1 stops the 400 mm float; o kept 0; model and honesty checks unchanged; the screening's original verdict's limiter (2)/(3) unchanged

v_check_polish.note: independent fast re-measure (Bench 60/160 grid, model as committed) reproduces gap 58.90 to the digit; the CB_EXACT=1 run did not finish in 70 min on a 4-core box at load 12 (per-pose libigl path), so the exact number is still owed; v_* fields above are the earlier audit of a different config (k86 + dpsi 0 + q 0.98) and are not overwritten

mechanism.notes: counted at the best config (k306, o = 0). bodies: link 1, bar (+ rod boss + O6 rod), linear-rotary sleeve, U ring (cross), cheek bracket on the cuff (arm-end). joints: J1, J2 O20 hubs, sleeve on the rod (one cylindrical pair: ACTIVE spin J3 + PASSIVE slide), U inner and outer axes (MR52). sensed: the 2 U angles - constant on the bench (o = 0) but tilted ~4.5 deg per 15 mm of GH shift on a body (audit), so exact tracking needs them read (or that error judged); J3's encoder must read the spin of a sliding sleeve (keyed magnet carrier). custom: base, link 1, bar, rod, sleeve housing, U ring, cheek bracket, 2 hub shafts, 2 U pins (est.); catalogue: 2 x MR117 pair, drylin RJMP-01-06, 4 x MR52 (est.).
